name: CX-to-CRM AI Promo Guard & Proactive Recovery

nodes.name: Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event
nodes.notes: Unified intake for AfterShip/Sendcloud carrier exceptions, Trustpilot 1-2 star reviews, and Zendesk/HubSpot new/open support tickets.

nodes.name: Shopify: Lookup Order & Customer LTV
nodes.notes: Filtered lookup by order_id (never fetches all store orders). Configure httpHeaderAuth with X-Shopify-Access-Token. Resolves missing email and customer LTV.

nodes.name: Resolve Customer Email & VIP Status

assignments.name: is_vip
assignments.value: ={{ (Number($json.orders?.[0]?.customer?.orders_count ?? $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.orders_count ?? 0) >= 3) || (Number($json.orders?.[0]?.customer?.total_spent ?? $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.total_spent ?? 0) >= 300) }}

assignments.name: event_summary
assignments.value: ={{ $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.message || $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.status || '' }}

nodes.notes: Computes resolved_email (webhook or Shopify order fallback), orders_count, total_spent, and is_vip (orders >= 3 OR total_spent >= 300 EUR).

nodes.name: AI: Triage Urgency & Draft Empathy Reply (JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a Customer Experience triage assistant. Return strictly JSON: theme (not_received | product_quality | delivery_delay | customer_service | other), priority_tier (P0 | P1 | P2 | P3), owner_team (logistics_cs | product_quality | logistics | customer_service), hold_days (7 | 14 | 30), internal_reply_draft (short empathetic draft in the customer language for a human agent; NEVER promise unapproved refunds or discounts), escalation_flags (array). Any mention of chargeback, bank dispute, legal threat, or VIP + stuck/lost parcel must be P0.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Strict JSON contract. Draft reply is saved ONLY as a private internal note for human review.

nodes.name: Parse AI Triage Output (Safe Defaults)

assignments.name: theme
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return JSON.parse(raw).theme || 'cx_issue_open'; } catch { return 'cx_issue_open'; } })() }}

assignments.name: priority_tier
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return JSON.parse(raw).priority_tier || 'P2'; } catch { return 'P2'; } })() }}

assignments.name: owner_team
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return JSON.parse(raw).owner_team || 'customer_service'; } catch { return 'customer_service'; } })() }}

assignments.name: hold_days
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return Number(JSON.parse(raw).hold_days) || 14; } catch { return 14; } })() }}

assignments.name: internal_reply_draft
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const raw = ($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '{}').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim(); return JSON.parse(raw).internal_reply_draft || 'AI draft unavailable — review order & customer context manually.'; } catch { return 'AI draft unavailable — review order & customer context manually.'; } })() }}

nodes.notes: Single safe parsing node supporting OpenAI and Gemini outputs so downstream Klaviyo/HubSpot/Zendesk/Slack nodes never fail on malformed AI responses.

nodes.name: Klaviyo: Set cx_promo_hold = true

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { type: 'profile', attributes: { email: $('Resolve Customer Email & VIP Status').item.json.resolved_email, properties: { cx_promo_hold: true, cx_review_request_hold: true, cx_hold_reason: $json.theme, cx_priority_tier: $json.priority_tier, cx_hold_days: $json.hold_days } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Uses resolved_email (never raw webhook body.email) and stable Klaviyo API revision 2026-10-15. Configure httpHeaderAuth with Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key YOUR_KEY.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Set CX Promo Hold = Yes
nodes.notes: Uses resolved_email from Shopify lookup/fallback to keep HubSpot suppression synced with Klaviyo.

nodes.name: Zendesk: Add Internal Note (Human-in-the-Loop Draft)
nodes.notes: Human-in-the-loop safety: posts draft ONLY as private internal note; never emails customers automatically. Swap for HubSpot Ticket node if running without Zendesk.

nodes.name: Guard: Is P0 Critical or VIP?
nodes.notes: Escalates to #cx-vip-alerts if AI flagged P0 (e.g. chargeback/legal threat) OR Shopify confirmed VIP status (orders >= 3 or LTV >= 300 EUR).

main.node: AI: Triage Urgency & Draft Empathy Reply (JSON)
HubSpot: Set CX Promo Hold = Yes
